posts.title: The Pumpkin situation
posts.description: Are pre-cut veggies more expensive than plain ones? This is one of the bigger questions when doing groceries. Today we explore this question by looking at … Pumpkins. Case study: Appie Pumpkin. As of today, one package Flespompoen stukjes costs 8.73€/kg. The same pumpkin costs 3.58 per piece. My test piece is 1,182g or about 1.2 kg or 3.02€/kg.
